distributedDependencyChecks.observed: Postgres 16 published as 127.0.0.1:5433 -> container 5432; bridge network internal=false; PostgreSQL password is loaded from Docker secret files; persistent volume postgres_data.
distributedDependencyChecks.runtimeCheck: container healthy; no unauthorized database login attempted
distributedDependencyChecks.riskBoundary: Host-published listener is loopback-only; other containers attached to orbi_net can reach container port.

distributedDependencyChecks.observed: ProductChat is AllowAnonymous with anti-forgery, 2-500 character validation and named assistant request timeout. Authenticated requests construct a prompt with full name, username, email and role; configured Ollama base URL is 127.0.0.1:11434.
distributedDependencyChecks.runtimeCheck: listener observed; no prompt sent; no prompt-injection claim
distributedDependencyChecks.riskBoundary: Identity context is forwarded when an authenticated user chats; no evidence of external transmission because only localhost Ollama is configured.

distributedDependencyChecks.observed: PaymentController has class-level Authorize; server creates and captures PayPal orders. Capture sends PayPal-Request-Id derived from order id and stores provider result.
distributedDependencyChecks.runtimeCheck: no payment, capture, callback, webhook or provider request executed
distributedDependencyChecks.riskBoundary: Callback/capture behavior and provider signature validation were not dynamically assessed.

distributedDependencyChecks.observed: Worker polls pending email rows every 15 seconds, increments attempts, persists status, then sends via MailKit.
distributedDependencyChecks.runtimeCheck: no message enqueued or manually sent; pre-existing app process hosts the worker, so background queue activity was not inspected.
distributedDependencyChecks.riskBoundary: Recipient data and SMTP credentials were not copied into audit artifacts.

distributedDependencyChecks.observed: BackupService defaults to a 5-minute interval and 12-file retention; uses pg_dump and psql. Administrative backup/restore routes were excluded from ZAP.
distributedDependencyChecks.runtimeCheck: no manual backup/restore initiated and no backup files inspected; pre-existing app process may run its scheduled worker.
distributedDependencyChecks.riskBoundary: No backup file, retention deletion or restore performed by audit.

distributedDependencyChecks.observed: Product query is sent to Fybeca, Pharmacys and Medicity over HTTPS GET in parallel; Sonar reports regex timeout issues in parsing/normalization.
distributedDependencyChecks.riskBoundary: External query disclosure, response size and timeout behavior were not dynamically tested.
